description: This file defines the IAsyncObservable<T> interface in the Orleans.Streams namespace, which generalizes the standard .NET IObservable interface to support asynchronous consumption of stream items, including subscription methods with optional filtering and starting point tokens.

classes.name: IAsyncObservable<T>
classes.description: An interface that allows asynchronous subscription to a stream of items, supporting optional starting tokens and filters.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Subscribes an asynchronous observer to the observable stream, returning a handle for managing the subscription.

methods.name: SubscribeAsync
methods.description: Subscribes an asynchronous observer to the stream starting from a specific sequence token with optional filter data, returning a handle for managing the subscription.
